model_annotation: This plot illustrates the coverage of different models as a function of the number of completions. The x-axis is labeled "Number of completions (k)" with a linear scale, ranging from 0 to 8, with a tick label interval of 2. The y-axis is labeled "Coverage" with a linear scale, ranging from 0 to 1.0, with a tick label interval of 0.2. The plot contains four lines: Llama-1B is represented by a blue line with circle markers and a solid style, starting at approximately (0, 0.07) and increasing to around (8, 0.83); Llama-1B + FT is depicted by a green line with triangle markers and a dashed style, beginning at about (0, 0.13) and rising to roughly (8, 0.93); the legend also mentions Llama-1B-8B and Llama-1B-8B + FT, but these are not visible in the plot. All visible lines show an increasing trend as the number of completions increases.
